g.text: Procurement ingestion - full flow of one new procurement
1. Discovery (through the Gate: tier new_day or history)
Ask the e-GP announcement feed for ONE agency,
ONE type (B0 draft or D0 invitation) and ONE day
Save the agency-day to the Feed Cursor
2. Detail turn (Gate tier detail, once per project)
3. Retrieval turn (Gate tier fresh, ONE hold)
check content-type and PK magic number
4. Analysis (outside the Gate - Vertex AI only)
(unsafe members are surfaced in the failure log)
Gemini classifies and analyses each PDF
Read invitation PDF -> official bid deadline
